extracted.intended_audience: EPO examiners, patent attorneys/agents and applicants before the European Patent Office
extracted.subtask_description: Comprehensive table-of-contents for the European Patent Office's Guidelines for Examination covering formalities, search, substantive examination, opposition, procedural matters, application content, patentability, and amendments. Intended as an authoritative checklist and guidance for handling European patent applications and proceedings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preliminary remarks
rubrics_metrics.description: Introductory guidance and high-level statements about the Guidelines for Examination (general framing and scope).

rubrics_metrics.name: Explanatory notes
rubrics_metrics.description: Notes explaining how to use and interpret the Guidelines and any editorial/conceptual clarifications.

rubrics_metrics.name: General remarks
rubrics_metrics.description: General principles and overarching considerations applying across the Guidelines and EPO practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Work at the EPO
rubrics_metrics.description: Description of internal EPO work practices and organisation relevant to examination and proceedings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Summary of the processing of applications and patents at the EPO
rubrics_metrics.description: Summary of procedural stages and processing steps for European applications and granted patents at the EPO.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contracting states to the EPC
rubrics_metrics.description: List / implications of EPC contracting states relevant to filing, validation and territorial scope.

rubrics_metrics.name: Extension to and validation in states not party to the EPC
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules and procedures for extending/validating European patent rights in non-EPC states.

rubrics_metrics.name: Filing of applications and examination on filing
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements and procedures for filing a European patent application and the preliminary examination performed on filing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examination of formal requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Criteria and checks for formal compliance of an application (documents, form, signatures, required elements).

rubrics_metrics.name: Special provisions
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific or exceptional formal/procedural provisions that apply in particular situations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Communications concerning formal deficiencies; amendment of application; correction of errors
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedure for notifying formal deficiencies, opportunities and rules for amending the application and correcting errors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publication of application; request for examination and transmission of the dossier to examining division
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules on publication timing, requesting substantive examination, and transmission of files to the examining division.

rubrics_metrics.name: Languages
rubrics_metrics.description: Language requirements for filing, proceedings, translations and communication before the EPO.

rubrics_metrics.name: Common provisions
rubrics_metrics.description: Common/formulaic provisions applying to formalities across different types of proceedings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Drawings
rubrics_metrics.description: Formal and substantive requirements for drawings included in European patent applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fees
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules on fees: which fees are due, timing, consequences of non-payment and fee structure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inspection of files; communication of information contained in files; consultation of the European Patent Register; issuance of certified copies
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures and rights to inspect prosecution files, access register information and obtain certified extracts/copies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Characteristics of the search
rubrics_metrics.description: Qualitative expectations and defining characteristics of the EPO search (scope, thoroughness, limits).

rubrics_metrics.name: Search procedure and strategy
rubrics_metrics.description: Recommended procedures, strategies and approach to conducting prior-art searches at the EPO.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preclassification, IPC and CPC classification of European patent applications
rubrics_metrics.description: Classification practices and rules for assigning IPC/CPC classes and preclassification steps.

rubrics_metrics.name: The state of the art at the search stage
rubrics_metrics.description: What constitutes the 'state of the art' for the purposes of searching, and how to assess it at search stage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Unity of invention (search stage)
rubrics_metrics.description: Assessment of unity of invention for purposes of the search (how many inventions to search, partial searches).

rubrics_metrics.name: Subject-matter to be excluded from the search
rubrics_metrics.description: Types of subject-matter that should not be included in the search (excluded technical/subject categories).

rubrics_metrics.name: Search documentation
rubrics_metrics.description: Content and form of the search documentation to be produced (records, citations, bibliographic data).

rubrics_metrics.name: Search report
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements, contents and form of the European search report (documented prior-art citations, classifications).

rubrics_metrics.name: The search opinion
rubrics_metrics.description: The search opinion's purpose, content and how it complements the search report (preliminary assessment on patentability).

rubrics_metrics.name: Formal requirements to be met before the division starts substantive examination
rubrics_metrics.description: Prerequisites and formal checks that must be satisfied prior to starting substantive examination by the examining division.

rubrics_metrics.name: The first stage of examination
rubrics_metrics.description: Initial substantive examination steps and considerations when the examining division first examines the file.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examination of replies and further stages of examination
rubrics_metrics.description: How to examine applicant replies, subsequent examination steps and iteration between office and applicant.

rubrics_metrics.name: The final stage of examination
rubrics_metrics.description: Criteria and procedures for concluding substantive examination, including grant decisions or refusal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Standard marks for indicating amendments or corrections by the divisions (Annex)
rubrics_metrics.description: Standard editorial/markup conventions used by EPO divisions to indicate amendments/corrections in documents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Time limits and acceleration of examination
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules on procedural time limits, extensions, and options/procedures for accelerated processing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Other procedures in examination
rubrics_metrics.description: Miscellaneous or exceptional procedural mechanisms available during substantive examination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Work within the examining division
rubrics_metrics.description: Internal division-level organisation, allocation of tasks and decision-making processes within examining divisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Special applications
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures and considerations for special categories of applications (e.g., special procedural status, e.g., PCT national phase peculiarities).

rubrics_metrics.name: General remarks (Opposition and Limitation/Revocation)
rubrics_metrics.description: Overarching principles and intro guidance for opposition, limitation and revocation proceedings.

rubrics_metrics.name: The opposition division

rubrics_metrics.name: Opposition
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedural and substantive rules governing filing and prosecution of oppositions against European patents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Procedure up to substantive examination (opposition)
rubrics_metrics.description: Preliminary steps and procedural handling of an opposition up to the point of substantive examination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Substantive examination of opposition
rubrics_metrics.description: How the opposition division assesses grounds of opposition substantively (novelty, inventive step, added subject-matter, sufficiency, etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: Procedure for the examination of the opposition
rubrics_metrics.description: Formal procedural steps for handling and examining the opposition (timelines, communications, evidence handling).

rubrics_metrics.name: Details and special features of the proceedings (opposition)
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific or exceptional procedural features that may occur during opposition proceedings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Decisions of the opposition division
rubrics_metrics.description: Form, content and legal effects of decisions issued by the opposition division (revocation, maintenance, amendment).

rubrics_metrics.name: Costs (opposition)
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules and principles concerning allocation and assessment of costs in opposition proceedings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Limitation and revocation procedure
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures available under the EPC for limiting or revoking patents centrally at the EPO.

rubrics_metrics.name: Communications and notifications (general procedural matters)
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules for communications, notifications and service in EPO proceedings (how and when communications are made).

rubrics_metrics.name: Oral proceedings
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules and conduct for oral proceedings before examining and opposition divisions (requests, hearings, evidence, languages).

rubrics_metrics.name: Taking and conservation of evidence
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards and procedures for presenting, taking and preserving evidence in EPO proceedings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Derogations from the language of the proceedings in oral proceedings
rubrics_metrics.description: Circumstances and rules under which language derogations are permitted in oral proceedings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examination by the EPO of its own motion; facts, evidence or grounds not submitted in due time; observations by third parties
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules on ex officio examination by the EPO, late-filed facts/evidence and third-party observations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Interruption, stay and consolidation of the proceedings
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures for suspending, staying or consolidating related proceedings and the conditions for doing so.

rubrics_metrics.name: Time limits, loss of rights, further and accelerated processing and re-establishment of rights
rubrics_metrics.description: Comprehensive rules on procedural time limits, consequences of missing them, acceleration options and restoration of rights.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applications under the Patent Cooperation Treaty (PCT)
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific provisions and interactions between PCT procedures and European patent processing (national phase, filings).

rubrics_metrics.name: Decisions (general procedural matters)
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules for drafting, notifying and reasoning decisions across different types of proceedings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Impartiality of the examining or opposition division
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards and safeguards to ensure impartiality of panels and decisions by examining and opposition divisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appeals

rubrics_metrics.name: Request from a national court for a technical opinion concerning a European patent
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedure and standards when national courts request technical opinions from the EPO regarding patents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Registration of changes of name, transfers, licences and other rights
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures for recording changes of ownership, licences and other rights in EPO records.

rubrics_metrics.name: Content of a European patent application (other than claims)
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements for the description, abstract and other non-claim parts of the application (structure, content, disclosure).

rubrics_metrics.name: Checklist for considering the abstract (F‑II, 2.5) (Annex 1)
rubrics_metrics.description: Checklist guidance on how to prepare and assess the abstract of a European patent application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Units recognised in international practice and complying with Rule 49(10) (Annex 2)
rubrics_metrics.description: Accepted measurement units and unit conventions that comply with Rule 49(10).

rubrics_metrics.name: Sufficiency of disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: Criteria for whether the application discloses the invention sufficiently for a person skilled in the art to carry it out.

rubrics_metrics.name: Claims (Art. 84 and formal requirements)
rubrics_metrics.description: Formal and clarity requirements for claims under Article 84 and related formal checks.

rubrics_metrics.description: Illustrative examples to determine which features are essential for defining claim scope.

rubrics_metrics.name: Unity of invention (application content)
rubrics_metrics.description: Assessment of unity within the application for formal and substantive purposes (single general inventive concept).

rubrics_metrics.name: Priority
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules and requirements for claiming priority and how priority affects entitlement and novelty.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patentability

rubrics_metrics.description: Circumstances under which prior disclosures do not prejudice patentability (exceptions and grace periods).

rubrics_metrics.name: Novelty

rubrics_metrics.name: Inventive step

rubrics_metrics.name: Alphabetical Keyword Index
